title: A large conjugated rigid dimer acceptor enables 20.19% efficiency in organic solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5356-5364
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00878F, Paper
Wendi Shi, Qiansai Han, Wenkai Zhao, Ruohan Wang, Longyu Li, Guangkun Song, Xin Chen, Guankui Long, Zhaoyang Yao, Yan Lu, Chenxi Li, Xiangjian Wan, Yongsheng Chen
A dimer acceptor QD-1 with a large conjugated rigid skeleton is reported, showing low disorder, weak electro-photon coupling, and thus low non-radiative recombination loss. An efficiency of 20.19% is achieved for the QD-1-based ternary device.
